newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Mortgage, Housing Bank merger seen in autumn.
newsitem.headline: Greek Mortgage, Housing Bank merger seen in autumn.

text.p: The merger of the National Mortgage Bank and National Housing Bank, both subsidiaries of the National Bank of Greece will be completed in autumn, said National Bank of Greece President Theodore Karatzas.
"It will have been completed in the fall," Karatzas told a news conference. "Personally, I think a legislative amendment has to be adopted."

The president of the state National Bank of Greece, the country's largest commercial bank, announced that the bank's profits before taxes and provisions rose 14.2 percent to 61.4 billion drachmas in 1996.
The profits will be used to write off bad loans following the approval by the bank's annual regular shareholders' meeting.
